tool_args.rationale: The endpoint history gap, coupled transient lag, and irregular raw prefixes match the archived two-state memory-kernel mechanism. Additional trajectory observations are needed to identify its four parameters and reconstruct the initial memory state.

considered_alternatives.option: Coupled memory-kernel ODE fitted to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Four coupled parameters and an unobserved memory state make five rows insufficient for reliable identification; the archived mechanism explicitly calls for at least eight.
The pilot signatures and raw trajectories point to transient memory rather than a static sink-gradient branch; the trajectory batch directly addresses the present ambiguity.
Deferred until the additional trajectories can distinguish it from the coupled transient mechanism.
